encodings.note: Perform specified SMX mode control as selected with the input EBX.

exceptions.when: If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[SMCTRL] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].

If CR0.PE = 0 or CPL > 0 or EFLAGS.VM = 1. If in VMX root operation. If a protected partition is not already active or the processor is currently in authenticated code mode. If the processor is in SMM. If the SMM monitor is not configured.
If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[SMCTRL] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].
GETSEC[SMCTRL] is not recognized in real-address mode.
If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[SMCTRL] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].
GETSEC[SMCTRL] is not recognized in virtual-8086 mode.
